name: Kaeru Otoko
source:
[Spoiler]According to Tamamoti's story, Frog Man was once a young human boy who was murdered and thrown off a bridge.  

After drifting in the river, he turned into a frog and lost his memory. When his memory returned, he tried to get revenge, but in the end he couldn't defeat a human.  

He came to the old bookstore to gain knowledge. [url=/c31755]Haruhiko[/url] guided him away from the path of revenge, and they've been friends ever since. They are often seen playing Go against each other.  

He can expand his height from 20cm up to 10m and his weight from 1kg up to 1t.[/spoiler]

Likes: Caramel. 
Dislikes: Snakes, scary people. 
Hobbies: Reading books. 
Role: First-year student at frog school. 

[Based on the [url=/r131128]fullscreen description[/url]] 

He's from [url=/c29350]Tamamori's[/url] novel "The Giant Toad's Rainy Season" and one of his imaginary friends.
